title: pleopeltis annabellae
intro: Pleopeltis annabellae, commonly known as the Resurrection Fern, is a species of epiphytic fern native to the tropical regions of Central America. The Resurrection Fern has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Pleopeltis annabellae include its potential to reduce stress, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antiparasitic properties. The bioactive constituents of the Resurrection Fern include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
